name: Eating Red Meat
overview: Scripture reveals that God's original provision for mankind was plant-based foods, as seen in Genesis 1:29 where He grants every seed-bearing herb and fruit for food. After the Flood, God expanded this provision to include all living creatures as food (Genesis 9:3), permitting the eating of red meat. However, the Mosaic Law introduced specific dietary restrictions, forbidding the consumption of fat and blood from animals (Leviticus 3:17; 7:23), and detailed which beasts were permissible to eat (Leviticus 11:1-2). These instructions demonstrate God's sovereign authority over diet and holiness in eating practices.
